positions.prompt_last: last prompt token including assistant generation header
positions.response_last: last non-special generated token, before any elicited forecast

provenance.report_hash_definition: report_sha256 is SHA256 of the canonical JSON string encoding of report text, UTF8; report_text_utf8_sha256 separately hashes raw report UTF8 bytes.

final_freeze.report_hash_definition: report_sha256 is SHA256 of the canonical JSON string encoding of report text, UTF8; report_text_utf8_sha256 separately hashes raw report UTF8 bytes.
final_freeze.limits: Blind agent drafts plus score-blind adjudication/consistency review; not independent human annotations.

annotations.clean_supported_criteria: Substantive EOS report, support=supported, needs_adjudication=false, incomplete_fragment=false; this is a draft content stratum, not an honesty/intent label. Recommendation/refusal flags are retained separately.

punctuation_sensitivity.rule: Unique exact FINAL line with at most one optional terminal .!?; EOS required; no rescue of caps/ambiguous lines

exact_output_diagnostics.selection: Check ALL72 same-case/same-context neutral-favorable pairs for exact generated-token-ID equality; no score-based selection.
exact_output_diagnostics.limits: Post-hoc conditional exact-output subset; case-level summaries are descriptive. Identical text and actual reader context reuse the exact same cached deterministic reader call, so unchanged outcomes are not independent replications. Context-sensitive margins with identical output do not establish deceptive intent, causal belief use or population specificity. Reader quality limitations remain.

restoration_validity_sensitivity.selection: Require original/restored decisions both valid in BOTH stale and informed contexts (four decisions per case); no score-based selection.
